# Theme option keys holding a font reference in Pro with Cornerstone 7.9.4 (framework/functions/pro/migration.php; cornerstone/includes/theme-options/typography.php). *_font_family_selection holds a Font Manager _id (or "inherit"); *_font_weight_selection holds "fw-normal" or "fw-bold" and is resolved against the family key beside it.
x_body_font_family_selection	family	x_body_font_weight_selection
x_headings_font_family_selection	family	x_headings_font_weight_selection
x_logo_font_family_selection	family	x_logo_font_weight_selection
x_navbar_font_family_selection	family	x_navbar_font_weight_selection
x_body_font_weight_selection	weight	x_body_font_family_selection
x_headings_font_weight_selection	weight	x_headings_font_family_selection
x_logo_font_weight_selection	weight	x_logo_font_family_selection
x_navbar_font_weight_selection	weight	x_navbar_font_family_selection
